results.previous_best: \mathcal{O}(np^3) \text{ arithmetic and } \mathcal{O}(np^2) \text{ storage for direct infGMRES}; \mathcal{O}(np^3+p^4) \text{ arithmetic and } \mathcal{O}(np+p^3) \text{ storage for TOAR infGMRES}
results.quote: We derive incremental recurrences requiring O(_np_<sup>2</sup>+_p_<sup>3</sup>) arithmetic and O(_np+p_<sup>2</sup>) storage for _p_ Arnoldi steps, excluding factorization setup and assuming linear-cost coefficient actions and triangular solves.

results.previous_best: \mathcal{O}(np^3+p^4) \text{ arithmetic and } \mathcal{O}(np+p^3) \text{ storage for TOAR infGMRES}
results.quote: In the extreme case \(\tau=0\), Dynamic TiGMRES will refresh at every step, leading to its \(\frac{2}{3}np^3+\mathcal{O}(np^2+p^4)\) arithmetic and O(_np+p_<sup>3</sup>) storage complexity.

results.previous_best: \mathcal{O}(d(np^2+p^3)+p^4) \text{ arithmetic and } \mathcal{O}(np+p^3) \text{ storage for G-TOAR infGMRES}
results.quote: Summing over _m_=2_,...,p_, including initialization, therefore gives O(_d(np_<sup>2</sup>+_p_<sup>3</sup>)) arithmetic operations. The recovery vectors, compact matrices, and nested evaluator data require O(_np+dp_<sup>2</sup>) storage.
